# MultiSelect

A filterable field for choosing several options, each shown as a removable chip.

- **Import:** `import { MultiSelect } from "@kozmos-ds/react";`
- **Group:** Core
- **Platforms:** React, SwiftUI and Compose; linked to its Figma component through Code Connect.
- **Storybook:** <https://vodoco.github.io/kozmos-design-system/storybook/?path=/docs/components-multiselect--docs>

## Example

From its `Default` story.

```tsx
import { MultiSelect, ThemeProvider } from "@kozmos-ds/react";

const options = [
  { value: "filters", label: "Filters", description: "Show saved filters" },
  { value: "layers", label: "Layers", description: "Map and data layers" },
  { value: "routes", label: "Routes", description: "Route overlays" },
  { value: "alerts", label: "Alerts", description: "Operational notices" },
];

export function MultiSelectExample() {
  return (
    <ThemeProvider defaultTheme="light">
      <div className="w-96">
        <MultiSelect label="Tools" options={options} />
      </div>
    </ThemeProvider>
  );
}
```

## MultiSelect

It forwards its ref to `HTMLDivElement`. Its props are `MultiSelectProps`, which extends `Omit<React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>, "children" | "defaultValue" | "onChange">`.

- `clearable`: `boolean`, optional, default `true`.
- `defaultSearchValue`: `string`, optional, default `""`.
- `defaultValue`: `string[]`, optional, default `[]`.
- `disabled`: `boolean`, optional.
- `emptyText`: `string`, optional, default `"No results found"`.
- `error`: `boolean | string`, optional.
- `filterOption`: `(option: ComboboxOption, inputValue: string) => boolean`, optional, default `defaultFilterOption`.
- `helperText`: `string`, optional.
- `label`: `string`, optional.
- `maxSelected`: `number`, optional.
- `onSearchValueChange`: `(value: string) => void`, optional.
- `onValueChange`: `(value: string[], options: ComboboxOption[]) => void`, optional.
- `options`: `ComboboxOption[]`, **required**.
- `placeholder`: `string`, optional, default `"Select options"`.
- `readOnly`: `boolean`, optional.
- `required`: `boolean`, optional.
- `searchValue`: `string`, optional.
- `status`: `InputStatus`, optional, default `"default"`.
- `value`: `string[]`, optional.
- `wrapperClassName`: `string`, optional.

It also takes the attributes React's DOM types give it (`className`, `style`, `id`, `aria-*`, the event handlers among them).

## Types these props take

### ComboboxOption

From `@kozmos-ds/react`.

```ts
interface ComboboxOption {
  description?: string;
  disabled?: boolean;
  label: string;
  value: string;
}
```

### InputStatus

From `@kozmos-ds/react`.

```ts
type InputStatus = "default" | "error" | "warning" | "success";
```
